Monthly Climate Summary Table

ClimateSummaryTable.Rd

Calculates long-term monthly climatological summaries across years. Daily observations are first summarised within each calendar year: rainfall and solar radiation are summed, daily maximum and minimum temperatures are represented by monthly maxima and minima, and other variables are represented by monthly means. The resulting yearly monthly values are then averaged across years.

Usage

ClimateSummaryTable(data)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing Date, variable, and value columns.

Value

A tibble with one row per variable and one column per calendar month. Years with no non-missing observations for a month-variable combination are excluded from that climatological average; if all years are missing, the result is NA.
